_comment: Checkerboard fix (iii): 1167067's 14-day gradient with frozen_tke and CATKE's κ held constant in derivatives where κc ≥ 0.1 m² s⁻¹ (convecting and strongly mixed cells). frozen_tke alone (1170953) is right in stable columns and along stress (FD / adjoint 1.02) but 5-40x too large along convecting directions.
